Planner: Checking in about farewell routines this morning.  
Coordinator: Keep the Companion Animal Travel Desk focused on calm handoffs and clear notes.  
Planner: Safety takes priority over speed in every journey, and the cabin team should stay visible.  
Coordinator: <<FACT F034>> We also need the pet log reviewed before boarding starts.  
Planner: If any crate latch looks weak, flag it at once and hold the transfer.  
Coordinator: The senior coordinator wants prompt updates on hazards and on any animal distress.  
Planner: For the next departure, keep the family informed with respectful wording.  
Coordinator: <<FACT F047>> Mark any route change in the record and alert the cabin team.  
Planner: Coco was steady during the last check, but the notes still need a second look.  
Coordinator: I will file the handoff details now and keep the trail clear for the next shift.
